The real problem

Your business probably doesn't have a lead problem. It has a conversion problem.

A prospect finds your business. They visit your website. They call, submit a form, or request a quote.

Then they wait.

Every minute without a response gives them another reason to call your competitor. CallDirector connects your website, phone, messaging, CRM, and follow-up into one automated system designed to move opportunities toward becoming customers.

About

AI automation built on 22+ years of phone systems experience.

Enterprise voice engineering, now working for service businesses.

Rodrigue “HotRod” Dossouvi
Founder, CallDirector AI

CallDirector isn't just another website agency adding an AI chatbot.

For more than 22 years, I've worked as a VoIP engineer, designing, configuring, and supporting enterprise Cisco phone systems: call managers, voicemail, SIP trunks, and voice gateways. I know how calls get routed, where they get dropped, and what it costs a business when nobody picks up.

I started CallDirector because the tools finally caught up. AI can now answer, qualify, book, and follow up the way a great front desk would, around the clock. My job is to build that system around how your customers actually reach you, then keep improving it.

How we work.

Communication first

Every workflow starts from how your customers actually reach you.

We build, connect, and maintain the system so you can run your business.
